On this episode of the Superwall Podcast, I sit down with growth consultant Marcus Burke to detail the technical frameworks required to scale mobile subscription apps past six figures a month in Meta ad spend. The discussion focuses on user acquisition (UA) architecture, highlighting why traditional direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce content structures fail when applied to mobile app promotion campaigns. We evaluate the mechanics of the Meta algorithm, specifically looking at how ad creative dictates audience targeting optimization, placement composition, and data feedback loops.  

The workflow segments unpack the execution of a research pipeline combining anonymous Reddit forum mining with Claude LLM synthesis to identify hyper-specific consumer psychological profiles and emotional language patterns. Marcus details his creative testing methodologies, including asset diversification across static images, short-form video, and generative AI production tools like GPT Image. Additionally, the video provides an operational overview of backend media buying settings, explaining how to mitigate App Store install friction, structure multi-ad set budget allocation, execute web-to-app blog funnels, and counter trial-to-paid drop-offs using automated Meta value rules.
